topics.title: Howard Stern Reports Arab Fight at Birthday Show
topics.summary: During a birthday show, co-host Howard Stern reported an incident involving Lisa Sliwa who engaged in a physical altercation with unidentified individuals described as "Arabs." The fight occurred after hearing about a protest and involved pushing and shoving; Jack the limo driver was knocked down during the scuffle while Neil and Gary observed from afar.

topics.title: Curtis Leeward’s Concerns About Court
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard repeatedly cautions against Curtis Leeward appearing in court or before police due to his unpredictable behavior and questionable judgment. The conversation devolves into humorous speculation regarding his motivations and actions, including imagined scenarios involving staged events.

topics.title: Royalty, Record Sales & Dion Warwick
topics.summary: A caller recounts his experiences receiving minimal royalties from record sales despite over 12,000 cases sold and a $75 payout, contrasting this with Bruce Springsteen’s earnings. The conversation then shifts to criticisms of singer Dion Warwick's songwriting style, deemed lacking spontaneity.

topics.title: Meatloaf Discusses Peter Noon and Music Industry Exploitation
topics.summary: During a radio show, Meatloaf discusses his encounter with Peter Noon after he abruptly left the studio due to ‘being freaked out.’ The conversation shifts to Noon’s past guest appearances on shows like Mike Douglas’, revealing details about Herman Sermons selling Noon's music and exploring themes of exploitation within the British Invasion era music industry.

topics.title: The Peculiar Old Woman
topics.summary: A man recounts bizarre observations about an elderly woman, describing her as fragile and prone to sneezing fits that break her hip. She appears to be dating a red stone, eats dog food, is frequently poked by concerned onlookers, and has a strangely prune-like face – leading to humorous speculation about her past.

topics.title: Blues Performance & Caller Queries
topics.summary: The broadcast features an impromptu blues performance followed by callers discussing personal matters including seeking concert tickets for Kimberly Taylor and inquiring about a Tremblers band member named Peter, referencing past radio shows and artists like David Bowie.
